_comment: Multipart rather than variants because `lit` has no model of its own and multipart matches an
unlisted property as a wildcard. As variants this would be eight entries pointing at four
`lit` is deliberately invisible on the block: it means 'the block BELOW is hot', not 'this block
is burning', and a press that glowed would be claiming to power itself -- which is the exact bug
machines.md records the Infuser shipping with. It drives the steam in
HempPressBlock#randomDisplayTick and the flame in the screen, both of which point at the heat
